# Vignette

Darkens or tints the frame toward its edges, drawing the eye to the center.

<EffectDemo effect="vignette" />

## Usage

```ts
import { EffectComposer } from '@mk7s/xtree/core';
import { vignette } from '@mk7s/xtree/effects/vignette';

const composer = new EffectComposer(renderer);
composer.setScene(scene, camera);
composer.add(vignette({ preset: 'subtle' }));
renderer.setAnimationLoop(() => composer.render());
```

Every parameter is also a property: `effect.darkness = 0.5`. Uniform changes take effect on the next frame without recompiling.

## Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                | Default     | Range      | Description                                                                               |
| ------------ | ------------------- | ----------- | ---------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `darkness`   | number              | `0.5`       | 0 – 1      | How strongly the edges move toward the vignette color.                                    |
| `offset`     | number              | `0.5`       | 0 – 1.5    | Radius where the falloff starts, as a fraction of the half-diagonal.                      |
| `smoothness` | number              | `0.6`       | 0.01 – 1.5 | Width of the falloff (smooth mode).                                                       |
| `roundness`  | number              | `1`         | 0 – 1      | Smooth mode shape: 1 is a circle, 0 follows the frame aspect ratio.                       |
| `color`      | hex color           | `'#000000'` |            | Color the edges move toward.                                                              |
| `mode`       | 'smooth' \| 'eskil' | `'smooth'`  |            | Smooth uses a smoothstep falloff; Eskil is the quadratic vignette from three.js examples. |

Every effect also has `blend` (any of the 26 [blend modes](/reference/shaders#modes)), `opacity` (0–1) and `enabled`.

## Presets

| Preset      | Settings                                                               |
| ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `subtle`    | `darkness: 0.35`, `offset: 0.7`, `smoothness: 0.8`                     |
| `cinematic` | `darkness: 0.85`, `offset: 0.35`, `smoothness: 0.75`, `roundness: 0.4` |
| `tunnel`    | `darkness: 1`, `offset: 0.15`, `smoothness: 0.45`                      |
| `glow`      | `darkness: 0.4`, `offset: 0.55`, `smoothness: 0.9`, `color: '#3b2a6b'` |

Apply one with `vignette({ preset: 'name' })` or `effect.applyPreset('name')`; presets start from the defaults.

## Details

- **Family:** Color & tone · tracked as story X3.4 in the [plan](https://github.com/s4njee/xtree/blob/main/plan.md).
- **Passes:** reads only its own pixel, so it merges into the pass before it.
- **Masks:** set `effect.mask` to a texture, depth range or selection to limit where it applies; see [masks](/guide/masks).
- **Motion:** Static: nothing animates.
- **Size:** 5.0 KB gzip budget for `@mk7s/xtree/effects/vignette`, including the shared effect runtime.
